data: same development695, 1064 records, same 5 outer folds
formula: y_corrected=a*y_pred+b; one shared scalar slope/intercept for pooled left/right records
fitting: unweighted OLS over record-side pairs; train_affine uses predictions of outer refit on its 556 training people; inner_oof_affine uses four inner validation predictions within same 556 people
selection: No calibration selection using outer held people. Report both predeclared variants. Base hyperparameters remain previously selected within outer training people, no epoch reselection.
inner_limit: Base hyperparameters were selected using all outer-training internal scores, so inner OOF is not a fresh independent calibration set. Outer evaluation remains excluded.
evaluation: person macro MAE, mean/gap errors, tail bias, score bins, prediction SD, train/held metrics; no clipping, no arbitrary expansion
cnn: Baseline outer held predictions only available locally. Cannot fit calibration without train predictions. Prepare read-only refit checkpoint exporter, no CNN training or remote execution.
paper_relation: Tests affine postprocessing idea only. Original paper selected epoch using corrected validation RMSE and used multiple windows; neither reproduced here.

bootstrap.interpretation: conditional exploratory paired person resampling; no model-selection adjustment
